title: Reading Drill — A Trial of Night Deliveries
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: A Trial of Night Deliveries
passages.body:
**A** A bakery tested late deliveries to avoid congestion in the morning. Its manager asked the drivers to record both journey time and unloading time, because faster roads might save little if staff could not receive the goods.

**B** The first delivery arrived quickly, but the rear gate was locked. On the next night the manager installed a temporary key box and noted which driver had been given its code.

**C** New neighbours then complained about the metal platform. The team put rubber mats under the platform edges and asked a shop worker to listen outside during the next unloading.
